title: Blocksphere
summary: A company overview. And then something more.
notes: Blocksphere has worked with companies, institutions and product teams since 2017. This is an invitation to build with us.
Our history spans enterprise infrastructure, financial applications, decentralized products, education and applied AI.
A presentation can list credentials. The work behind those credentials is much bigger. Let’s step inside.

title: Built since 2017
summary: From the first ledger to systems with many moving parts.
notes: 2017: blockchain infrastructure and decentralized land records for Telkom Indonesia. Early work also included vehicle-parts traceability and agricultural contracts.
2018–2020: Biido exchange engineering, Ecoberingin waste traceability, BCA Finhacks, Pegadaian gold tokenization and BRI sugarcane management.
2021–2023: BNI loyalty infrastructure, DeBio, Myriad Social, Project Garuda consultation, Peruri infrastructure and Astra Honda Motors.
2024–2026: BPJS Kesehatan feasibility work, digital asset platforms, Agent1c, HedgeyOS and Hitomi. Different technologies, a continuous practice of building.

title: From paper to reality
summary: Architecture matters when it leaves the page.
notes: Pegadaian: reserve-backed gold tokenization architecture with fractional ownership, KYC and supply-parity smart contracts.
BNI: loyalty-point infrastructure and partner settlement logic. BRI: sugarcane farmer-management information and traceable harvest data.
Bank Indonesia: a contribution to Project Garuda’s consultative paper, covering architecture options, risks and digital-rupiah design considerations.

title: The people behind it
summary: Pandu Sastrowardoyo. Gilang Bhagaskara. Jean-Daniel Gauthier.
notes: Pandu Sastrowardoyo is Blocksphere's Director, a co-founder of Blockchain Zoo and the Indonesian Blockchain Association, and a Bloomberg Technoz host. Her public GitHub profile documents AI, blockchain and product work.

Gilang Bhagaskara is Managing Director, with a focus on enterprise blockchain architecture, implementation and education. Jean-Daniel Gauthier brings technical architecture, business analysis and more than two decades in IT and communications.
Together their work connects engineering, policy, education and public communication. Open the chapter details for profiles, portraits and publications.

title: We build products, too
summary: Myriad. DeBio. RealityChain. Agent1c. HedgeyOS. Hitomi.
notes: Myriad Social: decentralized identity and user-owned content. DeBio: privacy-oriented biomedical and bioinformatics services. RealityChain: multichain virtual worlds.
Agent1c.ai: an agentic operating shell. HedgeyOS: local-first agent workspaces. Hitomi: an Android AI companion with optional terminal integration.
Product engineering complements institutional delivery. It brings hands-on experience of interfaces, users, operations and the choices behind a working system.
